# reformer.com

> A community-focused news platform covering local events, healthcare issues, and civic engagement in the Brattleboro area.

reformer.com serves as a local news source for the Brattleboro region, emphasizing community events, healthcare labor issues, and reader opinions. The site maintains strong coverage of Brattleboro Memorial Hospital and local civic matters.

## Key Topics

- Brattleboro
- Local Events
- Community News
- Healthcare Labor
- Letters to Editor
- Opinion
- Brattleboro Memorial Hospital

## Community News & Events

- [Local Events](https://www.reformer.com/local-events): Local events and community news coverage for Brattleboro area
